# Animation library

Panel: Brand/Art Director, UX and conversion, Motion Designer, Front-end/a11y/performance engineer, Devil's-advocate creative director. Nothing in this file shipped from a round that scored under 8.

Each primitive has one owner. Blob and the plate: Lagoon. Clip reveal, marquee, split-flap: Strike. Parallax rings and the sticky ring: Orrery, with WebGL left on the Orrery page. Stagger squash of the shell, not the word: Rally. Scramble, scan, three-frame digits, scroll-progress scaleX: Array. Pause sets intensity off. Spotlight, beams, magnetic targets, a generic count-up, and a shared spinner are not in the library.

Motion scored the library items 8 or 9 and found no similar pair. Art scored them 8 to 10. The devil required the marquee to stay a fixture line with a pause, which it is.
